description.value: Car people, truckers, transportation afficionados, air-pirates, they are the sole carriers of product across the world, maintaining the transport and supply chains in the time of the Red.
The Nomad Rocker is a Poor Quality Exotic Very Heavy Pistol that fires rocks. Ammo is free for this weapon. Full rules can be found in Black Chrome on Page 115.

As well as normal Grenade Ammunition, this weapon can fire road flares*. They don't deal any damage, but if fired into the air can be seen from 3 miles. You cannot install this weapon in Pop-up Cyberware.

*Currently not supported so will need to manually delete a road flare from actors inventory after firing

A small two-seater rotorcraft.

Can be applied to all vehicles. Adds a tank of nitrous oxide to the vehicle. Allows you to use your Action to use an additional Move Action while driving. 

You may install this upgrade multiple times, each upgrade adds an additional tank and each tank may be used once per day.
Can be applied to all vehicles. All glass on the vehicle is now considered cover with 15 HP. Can be taken a second time to upgrade to 30HP. All windows take damage individually.

Can be applied to all vehicles. Adds two seats to the vehicle. These can be installed as an external sidecar, they may also be installed as ejector seats with removable parachutes.

Can be taken multiple times with the exception of Bikes, Jetskis and Gyrocopters.

Injecting a target with Speedheal immediately causes them to heal HP equal to their BODY plus their WILL. This effect does not work on Mortally Wounded targets, and can only be used on a target once per day.

A basic lob or pitch of an object. Use an Action to make a Ranged Attack at up to 25m/yds. Targets can choose to Dodge your throw if they can Dodge bullets. Melee weapons deal their base damage, but don't penetrate half SP.
